notes:
Lead: VP Product (Maya Chen) — mid-market B2B SaaS (product analytics onboarding). Wants to build an in-app onboarding copilot that sits inside product UI to guide new users through flows. Primary evaluation path: Hosted API POC (2 weeks) -> if latency & cost OK then Dedicated sizing + pricing negotiation.

POC scope: integrate streaming chat with tool-calls (open url, run sample query, fetch user state). Show 1) streaming start latency, 2) per-token cost caps enforceable, 3) reliable function/tool calling with structured JSON outputs.

Acceptance criteria (agreed on 2026-03-04 call):
- Streaming first-byte start <= 150ms median and <= 300-350ms 95p for US region (interactive flows).
- End-to-end 95p response time for typical 150-400 token replies <= 400ms.
- Enforce token/session cap at 1,500 tokens; show cost estimation per session and per-MAU projection.
- Tool-calling success >= 98% for defined hooks; deterministic JSON schema.

Customer noted on call: "We can't have variable tail latency — users drop off if spinner > 500ms." Wants fallback routing to smaller quantized model if latency spikes. Interested in Redwood's prefix caching for common onboarding prompts.

Security & compliance: SSO->SAML in place, legal needs audit log retention policy and KMS integration (customer-managed keys) for Dedicated. Also asked about data residency options (EU customers).

Commercial: finance asked for firm committed cost caps if we move to Dedicated. Currently estimating $120k-$300k ARR depending on usage; they will push for volume discounts and capped overage.

Next tactical items (AE/SE):
- SE to deliver POC plan & test harness by 2026-03-11 (Daniel).
- Devs: integrate streaming SDK + function-calling surface this week; wire in telemetry for 95p latencies.
- AE to send Dedicated sizing + preliminary TCO scenario after POC metrics (Sophie).
- Legal to review SOC2 + ISO language; send security FAQ link (Olivia).

Short notes/fragments from calls: "streaming start latency is showstopper"; "token caps non-negotiable for pilot"; "prefer Redwood verified models but open to quantized variants for Dedicated"; "want demo with 500 concurrent onboarding sessions simulated."
